correctness.rationale: For every fixed q>=2,k>=1, orthonormal single-letter functions tensor to a complete word basis. The pointwise delta identity gives U_N=(sum_a S_a,N^2)/(2q^k)-N/2 and mean C(N,2)/q^k. A nonempty decorated pattern has zero covariance with a nonidentical translate; classify patterns by anchored support span d. Its k-d placements differ only O(k) boundary terms and therefore all share the same asymptotic standard-normal coordinate. Distinct anchored patterns have zero correlations at all shifts; finite-range dependent multivariate CLT supplies independent limits. The spectrum has k/q^k mult q-1, (k-d)/q^k mult (q-1)^2q^(d-1), d=1..k-1, and 0 mult q^(k-1). Fourth cumulants O(N) for bounded m-dependent sequences give N^2 variance coefficient from sum squared eigenvalues with O(N) residual. Checked cases (q,k)=(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2) by independent direct rational word-overlap covariance matrices and exact eigenvalues. Finite checks corroborate, do not establish the all-q,k limit.
